versions.changelog:
No visible changes detected in this release.

- Version bump to 1.1.0, but SKILL.md content remains unchanged.

Initial release of the countries-api skill, providing instant access to free country and location data via countries.dev.

- Query country info by name or ISO code, including capitals, currencies, flags, and borders
- Search for cities, places, and postal/ZIP codes; perform reverse geocoding
- Lookup IP geolocation and country information
- Calculate distances between coordinates or places
- No API key required; all endpoints are public and easy to use
